mistakes.quote: I go... my city to, uh, another city.
mistakes.correction: I went from my city to another city.
mistakes.note: Past simple tense is required for completed actions in the past. 'From...to' is the correct prepositional phrase for describing movement between locations.
mistakes.practice: Complete these sentences using the past simple tense: 'Yesterday, I ____ (go) to the store.' 'Last week, we ____ (visit) our grandparents.'

mistakes.correction: Because people have more money now.
mistakes.note: This is a sentence fragment. It needs a subject and a complete verb phrase.
mistakes.practice: Rewrite these fragments as complete sentences: 'Because tired.' 'Because good weather.'

mistakes.note: Excessive hesitation disrupts the flow of speech. Try to reduce filler words like 'um' and 'uh'.
mistakes.practice: Record yourself speaking for 30 seconds on a familiar topic. Identify and count the number of filler words you use.
